declare

 SELECT note_id
 FROM units
 WHERE chapter_id = :GLOBAL.CHAPTER_ID
 AND unit_id = pc_unitID; 

 CURSOR compNote_cur(pc_unitID VARCHAR2, pc_productCD VARCHAR2) IS
 SELECT note_id
 FROM components
 WHERE chapter_id = :GLOBAL.CHAPTER_ID
 AND unit_id = pc_unitID
 AND product_code = pc_productCD; 
 
 l_sql VARCHAR2(2000);

 || ' SET note_id = LN$NoteID ' 
 || ' WHERE chapter_id = ''' || :GLOBAL.CHAPTER_ID || ''''
 || ' AND unit_id = ''' || :units.unit_id || '''';

 */

 CLOSE unitNote_cur;
 ELSE
 ln_noteID := :units.note_id;
 END IF;
 
 CALL_WINDOW_FOR_NOTES(pl_notes_for => 'UNIT_ID', 
 pl_value => 'Unit ID - ' || :units.unit_id ,

ProgramUnit.Name: CALCULATE_TIME_LOCAL
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
function calculate_time_local (start_time in date,
 end_time in date)
 return varchar2 is
 temp_sec number;
 temp_hr number;
 temp_min number(2);
 temp_diff varchar2(10);
 begin
 temp_sec :=(end_time - start_time)*24*3600;
 if temp_sec is null
 then
 return('');
 end if;
 temp_hr := floor(temp_sec/3600);
 temp_min := round((temp_sec-(temp_hr*3600))/60);
 /* if temp_hr not between 0 and 999
 then
 temp_diff := '';
 else
 Commented by Sobha PR 001.033211*/
 temp_diff := lpad(to_char(abs(temp_hr)),5,'0') || ':' ||
 lpad(to_char(temp_min),2,'0');
 --end if;
 return(temp_diff);
 end;
